collections.title: Sikkim
collections.description: Rivers through deep valleys, mountains behind cloud, and the changing light between them.

collections.title: Esplanade
collections.description: A walk through the centre of Kolkata: passing faces, roadside stalls, and a city always in motion.

collections.title: Kumartuli
collections.description: Inside the workshops of Kumartuli, clay takes shape in the hands of the people who know it best.

collections.title: Princep Ghat
collections.description: Boats cross the Hooghly as the light changes, beneath the long sweep of Vidyasagar Setu.

collections.title: Mullick Market
collections.description: Flowers change hands in the crowded lanes of the market, where colour and everyday work meet.

collections.title: Howrah Bridge
collections.description: A little space beside the river: people at work, passing boats, and the bridge above it all.

collections.title: Delhi
collections.description: Stone, water, and the geometry of Delhi’s historic spaces, seen through the shifting light of the day.
